summary.text: Full Stack Engineer with experience in distributed backend systems and microservices-based architectures. Strong background in REST APIs, PostgreSQL schema design, Redis performance optimization, and independently deployed services communicating over HTTP. Solid foundation in object-oriented programming (C++), comfortable reading and navigating JVM-based codebases, and adapting to new stacks. Experienced in AI-driven engineering workflows to accelerate delivery, improve code quality, and optimize development throughput in production environments.
